name: bedrock-advisor
description: An advisor tool for Claude Code on Amazon Bedrock: a stronger model reviews the calling agent's own transcript and returns guidance.

advisor_model.title: Advisor model
advisor_model.description: Alias (opus, sonnet, haiku) resolved through ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_<ALIAS>_MODEL, or a full Bedrock model or inference profile id

backend.title: Backend
backend.description: auto: the engine calls Bedrock and falls back to Claude Code's own model call on credential or access errors. bedrock: engine only. session: Claude Code's model call only

auto_consult.title: Consult on repeated errors
auto_consult.description: Consult the advisor automatically when the same tool error happens twice in a row, and attach the advice to the tool result

max_tokens.title: Advisor reply cap
max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens in one advisor reply

max_context_chars.title: Transcript budget
max_context_chars.description: Maximum characters of the agent's transcript sent to the advisor

engine_path.title: Engine path
engine_path.description: Absolute path to advisor-engine. Set by the installer; leave empty to use the default location
